name: Infinite Temple
description: Raymarched endless colonnade at golden hour: Repeat3D pillars and arches, mirror-polished floor with a second reflection march, soft shadows, AO, sun-scattering fog, screen-space god rays, ACES film grade, bloom, chromatic aberration, vignette and grain. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Walk, Light, Floor, Post, Dust and Music.

data.text:
# Infinite Temple
An endless raymarched colonnade at golden hour: repeated pillars and arches, a mirror-polished marble floor with a real second bounce, god rays, bloom and floating dust.
Reacts to music: open the audio menu → Mic (god rays swell on the bass, the lens streak flares on the beat, dust sparkles on the highs).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Walk, Light, Floor, Post, Dust and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Scene SDF
Repeat3D tiles one cell of the temple forever: fluted columns (box, tori and a cosine-grooved cylinder, smooth-unioned) and two rows of arches (boxes minus rotated cylinders), over a floor plane.

## Material / Shading
A checkered marble floor with domain-warped veins, sun Lambert + Blinn-Phong, sky and bounce light by height, and a Fresnel rim on stone.

## Mirror Reflection
A second Raymarch along the reflected ray, shaded with the same lights and fogged, blended in by Fresnel on the polished floor tiles only.

## Render Targets
The graded frame (ACES, gamma, shadow tint; alpha = sun glare) goes into a Feedback buffer; bright-pass buffers feed the bloom chain.

## God Rays & Bloom
Radial god rays from the sun's screen position, three bloom levels and a warm lens streak.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the temple looks exactly as before. drive = music × smoothstep(level).
- Bass: god-ray intensity swells up to +50%.
- Beat: the warm lens streak flares (×2.2) with a short attack and decay.
- Highs: the dust motes sparkle up to ×2.5 on hats and cymbals.
Beat-phase couplings (lens-streak flare) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence (Beat.confidence = u_beatConfidence: 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome) and run on the stable beat clock with its certainty gate (Beat.gate / BeatEnvelope gate: fade, u_beatTrust): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and these couplings fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (bass god rays, high dust sparkle) are not.
